_about: Git problem repositories published by `python -m eliozo_dao.import_problems`.
For every listed olympiad directory, each <problembase>/<olympiad>/<event>/content_<lang>.md is converted to Turtle.
The olympiad's own config.json supplies default_lang (that file is the master, the others are translations) and exclude_events.
exclude_events below is added to those. local_checkout is resolved against this file's directory and, when it exists,
is used instead of cloning git_url (pass --source git to force a clone, as the Jenkins load_rdf pipeline does).
